_readme: Oracle for tests/fixtures/onboarding. Declared BEFORE any LAIN query — the runner asserts against this file, never against what the tool happened to answer. A query that returns empty where this file says non-empty is a FAIL, never a pass.

fixture.pre_edit_behavior: strip + lowercase only; internal whitespace runs are NOT collapsed
fixture.post_edit_behavior: also collapse internal whitespace runs to a single space

decoys.reason: similar name, no Calls edge to normalize_token — must never appear as a dependent

edit.description: normalize_token collapses internal whitespace runs to a single space (e.g. '  A   B  ' -> 'a b'), public function names unchanged, tests/ untouched

staleness_window.before_commit: must NOT report the new caller, and must explain the gap — a silent bare answer here is a FAIL (empty is never 'no risk')

index_updated.after: git commit of the change — the unit the index follows (the tool's own error says 'committed and re-indexed'); the update lands with the next indexing pass (a fresh lain session)
index_updated.stale_would_look_like: no callers / symbol not found — which is a FAIL, not 'no risk'
index_updated.live_session_note: a session that was already running does not pick up new commits within 60s; re-query from a fresh session. Recorded as a documentation finding: README 'updates on change' needs this qualification.
